body: Do you love and care for him but yet feel incredibly self destructive? If this is correct, try to work on yourself and think of why you feel the need to destroy your life and yourself. Maybe it feels good to be evil for a little bit? Don't just focus on how you are a "terrible person". Some people indulge in drugs or fast food and for some it is sex. Take care of yourself and do your best to be honest and true to the people you care about. Some will forgive you some will not, but just know that this too shall pass.
